Entries.Text: Bring another mod's time act changes into this project without losing yours. Each source is compared with the game's copy: what only they changed is taken, what only you changed is kept, and where both of you changed the same thing you choose. Two mods changing different events of one animation combine. Applying is one undo step.
Merge another mod's anibnd, or a single .tae into the selected source, without losing your changes. Opens the Merge tool with the file and analyses it; nothing changes until you apply.
Where the other side of the merge comes from.
Another Smithbox project for the same game. Only the anibnds in its own folder are read.
A mod's folder: the one holding chr (or chr itself, or a folder inside it). Every anibnd at one of this project's paths is merged; character anibnds this project doesn't have can be added.
One anibnd or container, matched by its file name; or one .tae, merged into the selected source as its time act of the same name. A single file brings no clips: use a folder for those.
